fields: L5 Shanghai / Dragon Boat Festival (e-bike; Lujiazui → the Bund → Huaihai Road → Xintiandi). Same item fields as L3 v3.1 / L4. Pools keep L3 names so pickSetL2 + l3TypeUniq can be reused: seawall = 端午摊 Zongzi Stall questions (3–4 choices, timed 30 s; also the retry pool), forest_fork = fork signs (≤3 choices; sign_en/sign_zh; EN ≤24 chars, ZH width ≤12), peak_final = Xintiandi-entrance final (exactly 4 choices, hard, situational). Per run: 3 timed stall in segment 1 + 4 fork in segment 2 + 2 timed stall and 1 Xintiandi final in segment 3 = 10 (one stall pool, drawn as 5 then split 3+2; do not place all 5 timed questions in the first segment). Every item has qtype + qtype_zh (each qtype at most once per run). {name} = player name; English on top, Chinese below. No subject capybara/beaver. Festival riddles are object/animal riddles solvable in both languages (subject 'riddle'), labelled Festival riddle: / 端午谜：. Stems are deduped against all L1–L4 banks (all grades).

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Why is the moon not full on Dragon Boat Festival?
questions.q_zh: 为什么端午节那天月亮通常不是满月？
choices: The festival is on lunar day 5, soon after new moon
Full moon is always on lunar day 1
The sun hides the moon all month
Shanghai has no moon in summer
choices_zh: 节日在农历初五，刚过新月
太阳整月把月亮藏起来
questions.explain_en: Full moon is around lunar day 15; day 5 is still a crescent.
questions.explain_zh: 满月大约在农历十五，初五还是弯月。

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A round sachet frame has a diameter of 35 cm. Using π ≈ 3.14, what is its circumference in cm?
questions.q_zh: 一个圆形香囊框直径 35 厘米，π 取 3.14，周长是多少厘米？

questions.subject: riddle
questions.q_en: Festival riddle: In early summer I turn the street into a green tunnel over Huaihai Road. What am I?
questions.q_zh: 端午谜：初夏时，我在淮海路上把街道变成一条绿色的隧道。打一景物，是什么？
questions.explain_en: Rows of plane trees meet overhead and make a green canopy.
questions.explain_zh: 成排的梧桐在头顶交会，像一条绿隧道。

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A Lujiazui map uses 1 cm for 200 m. Two plane-tree rows are 7 cm apart on the map. How many metres apart are they?
questions.q_zh: 陆家嘴地图上 1 厘米代表 200 米，两排梧桐在图上相距 7 厘米，实际相距多少米？

questions.subject: duanwu
questions.q_en: From the Bund, Flora watches a dragon boat: one person beats a drum and the paddles move together. That person is the ____.
questions.q_zh: Flora 在外滩看龙舟：有一个人敲鼓，船上的桨就一起动。那个人是____。
questions.explain_en: The drummer sets the stroke for the crew.
questions.explain_zh: 鼓手给全船定划桨节奏。

questions.subject: shanghai
questions.q_en: Riding from Lujiazui to the Bund, Flora crosses to the other side of the Huangpu in the story's scene change. Which pair is correct?
questions.q_zh: 故事里 Flora 从陆家嘴来到外滩，是到了黄浦江的另一边。下面哪一对是对的？
choices: Both sit on a high mountain pass
The Bund is in Pudong; Lujiazui is a village abroad
Lujiazui is in Pudong; the Bund is in Puxi
Both are in a desert oasis
choices_zh: 外滩在浦东，陆家嘴在国外村子
陆家嘴在浦东，外滩在浦西
questions.explain_en: Lujiazui is a Pudong area; the Bund is on the Puxi waterfront.
questions.explain_zh: 陆家嘴在浦东，外滩在浦西滨江。
questions.qtype_zh: 上海生活（梧桐/黄浦江/石库门）

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A cooler of zongzi at the Xintiandi door reads -6 °C. After it is opened it warms by 6 °C. What is the new temperature in °C?
questions.q_zh: 新天地门口一箱粽子的冷藏箱显示 -6 °C，打开后升高了 6 °C，现在多少摄氏度？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: On a Shanghai map, 1 cm stands for 250 m. The path from the Bund to Xintiandi is 10 cm on the map. How many metres is it really?
questions.q_zh: 上海地图上 1 厘米代表 250 米，从外滩到新天地的路在图上长 10 厘米，实际是多少米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Last year 600 visitors watched the dragon boats from the Bund. This year there are 15% more. How many visitors are there this year?
questions.q_zh: 去年有 600 位游客在外滩看龙舟，今年多了 15%，今年有多少人？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A Bund river-walk ticket costs a 6-yuan fee plus 12 yuan per person. Flora's group pays 30 yuan. How many people are in the group?
questions.q_zh: 外滩江边步行要付 6 元手续费，每人再付 12 元。Flora 一行共付了 30 元，一共几个人？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A sketch of the Xintiandi doorway is 4 cm wide and 6 cm tall. A similar banner copy is 12 cm wide. How tall is the banner in cm?
questions.q_zh: 新天地门口的草图宽 4 厘米、高 6 厘米，放大成相似的横幅后宽 12 厘米，高是多少厘米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Over four evenings, Flora counts 7, 9, 12 and 8 boats passing the Bund. What is the mean number per evening?
questions.q_zh: 连续四个晚上，Flora 在外滩数到 7、9、12、8 条船，平均每晚几条？
